The '''residence''' of [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]] was located in [[Rampart Town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was home to Obrim and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Telti Obrim]] and their two sons.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>

After [[Standoff in the Republic Central Medcenter|rescuing]] a wounded [[Fi Skirata]] from termination at the [[Republic Central Medcenter/Legends|Republic Central Medcenter]], Obrim brought him home where he was [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Bardan Jusik]], then later sent to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].
